theme: dead-letter retry board jobid:status SETMATCH ladder MOVELINE pin GREP suffix false friends

tests.name: seed_fail_ladder
tests.cmd: seed job_a..extra; fail a→retry; fail a→dead; fail b; succeed c

tests.name: pin_retry_requeue
tests.cmd: pin job_a; retry dead→retry; kill; requeue→pending

tests.name: require_miss
tests.cmd: CUBALC_DLQ_REQUIRE=1 fail ghost; pin empty attention

tests.name: countline_vs_grep_suffix
tests.cmd: COUNTLINE bag ':ok' vs GREP ':ok'+LINES; GREP ':ok' keeps job:okay

tests.name: setmatch_first_only
tests.cmd: SETMATCH two x:dead → one residual x:dead

tests.name: grep_prefix_false_friend
tests.cmd: GREP job_a matches job_a_extra+job_ab; GREP job_a: exact-ish
tests.note: need BEFORE+EQS or STARTS job_a: for identity

tests.name: write_no_final_nl
tests.note: last field often lacks trailing $ (WRITE bag glue)

weaknesses.title: GREP status suffix tallies are substring-unsafe for short statuses
weaknesses.detail: GREP ':ok' keeps both job_c:ok and job_d:okay. COUNTLINE cannot suffix-tally so agents must GREP then LINES — but short suffixes collide with longer status names. DLQ boards need exact AFTER ':' + EQS status walks or pure single-token fields.

weaknesses.title: COUNTLINE exact-only — no status-role tally form
weaknesses.detail: COUNTLINE bag ':dead' always 0. Agents expect 'count lines matching status' but get field equality. Same class as feature_flag_board W1; DLQ escalates because four statuses need four GREP+LINES and still false-friend.

weaknesses.title: SETMATCH first exact only — no multi-status or multi-job batch
weaknesses.detail: Duplicate job:dead leaves residual after one SETMATCH. Fail ladder is two sequential transitions not one form. No SETMATCHALL / SETMATCHWHERE status.

weaknesses.title: GREP jobid prefix without colon matches jobid_extra / jobidab
weaknesses.detail: GREP 'job_a' keeps job_a, job_a_extra, job_ab. GREP 'job_a:' is safer but still substring inside longer fields. Identity requires EACH+BEFORE+EQS or STARTS 'job_a:'.
weaknesses.repro: GREP 'job_a' on three cousins → n=3; STARTS/EQS identity → 1

weaknesses.title: No string concat — job:status tokens via REPLACEALL template
weaknesses.detail: NAME:VAL REPLACEALL corrupts if job id contains NAME or VAL substrings. Same class as flag/roster boards.
weaknesses.repro: template NAME:VAL with NAME containing VAL

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON collapses multi-line DLQ bags
weaknesses.detail: list dumps bag as job_a:pendingjob_b:retryjob_c:ok — unparseable for agents. Scalars n_pending/n_retry ok; plate remains truth.

weaknesses.title: WRITE bag often omits final trailing newline
weaknesses.detail: cat -A shows last job:status without $. Some tools treat as incomplete last line; READ still reloads fields via LINES but plate is ugly for shell pipelines.
weaknesses.repro: seed three jobs; cat -A DLQ.txt → last field no $

weaknesses.title: SYS RAND single negative used a<0&&b<0 sentinel (FIXED this iter)
weaknesses.detail: SYS RAND -3 was treated as no-args (0..999999) because negative a plus unset b both looked 'absent'. Fixed with has_a/has_b flags; non-positive single now correctly → 0. Selftest 79/79.
weaknesses.repro: pre-fix: SYS RAND -3 LAST_N random; post-fix: LAST_N==0

workarounds: Status tallies: GREP ':pending'|':retry'|':dead' then LINES — not COUNTLINE; prefer long unique status tokens
Exact status: EACH LINE + AFTER ':' + EQS status (or COUNTLINE full job:status token)
Job identity: EACH+BEFORE+EQS or STARTS 'jobid:' — never bare GREP jobid
Dedup dead before retry/requeue; or loop SETMATCH until COUNTLINE old==0
PRINT_JSON only n_* scalars; keep bag on DLQ.txt plate
After WRITE, optional APPEND empty or ensure final NL in host if shell tools need it
language_gaps: COUNTLINE suffix / field-pattern tally (or GREP count without materialize)
SETMATCHALL and status-where replace (set all job:* → job:ok)
PRINT_JSON newline escape in multi-line strings
WRITE option to force trailing newline on bag plates
Ends-with field match (ENDS bag ':ok' exact field suffix) distinct from GREP substring
issues_faced: Selftest red on sys_rand (SYS RAND -3) — sentinel bug, fixed in lang_ops_core.c has_a/has_b
GREP ':ok' false friend with ':okay' makes short status vocab dangerous for suffix tallies
fail ladder needs two SETMATCH hops; no atomic multi-step form
WRITE last-field missing NL visible in cat -A after seed
